name: Cloverdale Food
old_description: Cloverdale makes it easy to snack on-the-go with our shelf stable Beef Tangy Snackers® summer sausage sticks. Gluten-free, beef summer sausage sticks pack 5 grams of protein per serving. With outstanding taste and texture, this artisan, single serve stick of summer sausage is expertly seasoned for grab and go protein, and proudly made in the USA.
about:
Cloverdale Foods traces its roots to 1915, when founder Hoy Russell opened Mandan Creamery in Mandan, North Dakota. The small dairy operation quickly built a reputation for fresh, high-quality products, and within a few years the company expanded into premium pork items, laying the groundwork for the brand known today.

The company now produces shelf-stable beef summer sausage sticks under the Beef Tangy Snackers® name. Each gluten-free stick delivers 5 grams of protein and is marketed as an artisan, single-serve snack that is expertly seasoned and made in the USA. While specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed, the operation centers on meat processing, seasoning, and shelf-stable packaging for retail-ready snack products.

Cloverdale serves the consumer packaged goods and meat snack segments, selling directly to retail customers looking for convenient, high-protein on-the-go options. The product line is positioned for grocery, convenience, and specialty food channels, though the input does not name specific commercial accounts.

From its start, Russell insisted on uncompromising quality, a principle that remains the company's stated promise: to delight families with high-quality, flavorful meat products that create lasting memories.
